text: In N=128 seed 22, force's best layer drifts 3 to 4 to 3 and its final margin (0.094) falls under the bar because the layer-3 control is high (0.595, spread 0.048). Seed 23 keeps force at layer 1, the distance layer, and does beat its control. What is seed 22's layer-1 force R2 at step 12000? Is the seed-to-seed force difference at N=128 just whether the run develops a layer-1 1/r^2 read?
